title: Houthis blame Saudi Arabia for another strike on Sanaa's airport
summary_full: Air strikes were reported by Houthi-aligned media on Houthi-held territories including Sanaa international airport. The Saudi-led coalition condemned an earlier attack that caused civilian casualties and incurred fatalities from different nationalities. Houthi spokesperson warned against the use of Saudi airspace by airlines, asserting their military strategy. The conflict between the two sides has escalated, leading to significant civilian impacts and suffering.
